attempts.why: The .btn rule (display:inline-flex) is defined after .menu-toggle and has equal specificity so it overrides display:none, leaving the hamburger menu visible at 1200px where it should be hidden; increasing specificity to .btn.menu-toggle makes the hide rule win.
